description: This file defines data models for food items in a food delivery app, includes a sample list of food items, and includes methods to modify item quantities.

classes.name: FooditemList
classes.description: A class encapsulating a list of FoodItem objects.

classes.name: FoodItem
classes.description: A class representing a food item with properties such as id, title, hotel, price, image URL, and quantity, along with methods to modify quantity.

methods.name: incrementQuantity
methods.description: Increments the quantity of the food item by one.

methods.name: decrementQuantity
methods.description: Decrements the quantity of the food item by one.
